properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 20 at 7:38PM EDT until September 20 at 9:45PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Lee County in southwestern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 945 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 738 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Up to 2.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Cape Coral, Fort Myers, East Dunbar, Buckingham, Palmona Park,
Lochmoor Waterway Estates, Pine Manor, Villas, Olga, McGregor,
Cypress Lake, Harlem Heights, Iona, Tice, Page Field Airport,
Page Park, North Fort Myers, Suncoast Estates and Fort Myers
Shores.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 945 PM EDT THIS EVENING
